name: Mirror Lab
desc: A spherical-mirror lab: focal length, object distance and height sliders drive the mirror equation, with principal rays, image type and magnification shown live.
controls: Focal-length, object-distance and object-height sliders, three presets (concave/convex/plane), rays toggle, draggable object tip; keys 1–3 load presets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
